Name: Rare Naturally Spawning Fruit Trees
Author: vapor64
Description:
[size=3]This mod adds a rare chance for fruit trees to naturally spawn in the world.

[u][b]Tree spawning logic:
[/b][/u][/size][list]
[*][size=3]On Day 1 Year 1, there is a guaranteed chance for a fully-grown fruit tree to replace one of the wild trees at the farm map.[/size]
[*][size=3]On any other day, the game cycles through every location, and performs a probability check(1%). If it succeeds, it tries to spawn a fruit tree(in any growth stage). The number of trees spawned is always 1. The tree first tries to spawn in any plantable tile, if a plantable tile is not available, it tries to replace any naturally spawned wild tree.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[u][b]Configurable values(GMCM required):
[/b][/u][/size][list]
[*][size=3]SpawnChancePerDay - The chance that a fruit tree will spawn in a given location on a given day. Default: 1% per location per day.[/size]
[*][size=3]SpawnsPerSuccessfulRoll - How many trees to attempt to spawn in a location on days when the spawn roll succeeds. Default: 1.[/size]
[*][size=3]RandomizeStartingGrowthStage - If true, spawned trees start at a random young growth stage. If false, trees always start as seeds. Default: true.[/size]
[*][size=3]IncludeModdedTrees - If true, also consider modded fruit trees. Default: true.[/size]
[*][size=3]Per location toggles to allow fruit trees to spawn or not.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[u]Things to note:[/u][/size][list]
[*][size=3]This mod never replaces any wild trees planted by the player.[/size]
[*][size=3]Fruit trees spawning are season-specific, thus no fruit trees spawn in winter[/size]
[/list][size=3]
Please consider endorsing this mod if you find it helpful.

[b][u]Installation :[/u][/b][b][u]
[/u][/b][list]
[*]Download latest mod file
e.g. "RareNaturallySpawningFruitTrees1.0.0.zip"[*]Extract the contents of the mod file to your Stardew Valley mods folder
e.g. "[i]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\"[/i][*]Launch Stardew Valley using SMAPI
[/list]
[b][u]Compatibility :
[/u][/b][list]
[*]Tested on Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.1
[*]Not tested on Android yet
[/list]

[/size]
